issues.problem: ga-stative explain said 〜たい 'keeps を', implying 水が飲みたい is wrong; が is also standard with 〜たい.
issues.action: Stated that 〜たい takes を or が (水が飲みたい is also correct); 欲しい takes が only.

issues.problem: ga-stative contrast (を) said 〜たい 'keeps を', the same over-strict claim.
ga-sub-clause explain said から/ので/けど/と思う clauses contain は 'usually for contrast'; と思う and けど clauses take a plain topic は freely, and ので with は is the weakest example.
issues.action: Dropped ので and 'usually for contrast': 'can contain their own は'.

issues.problem: ga-sub-clause contrast (の) said to use が in 時 clauses, but 時 is a noun, so の is grammatical there (私の若い時).
issues.action: Rewrote: の replaces が only before a noun (including 時), never in たら/と/ば clauses; が is always safe.

issues.problem: ga-existence tip limited 'have' to family and events, leaving out possessions (車があります).
